subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's bootstrap glob walker and `agent:bootstrap` hook scheduling changes as the compatibility tradeoff for fixing the embedded-run event-loop stall?
rationale: The patch looks correct and keeps the SDK surface stable, but it changes upgrade-sensitive bootstrap context resolution and hook dispatch timing that existing users and plugins can observe.

options.title: Accept the guarded compatibility tradeoff
options.body: Merge after exact-head gates if maintainers agree the tested walker parity and internal-only scheduling are acceptable for the P1 message-loss fix.

options.title: Require broader live embedded-run proof
options.body: Ask for an end-to-end connected-channel or Gateway run before merge if maintainer confidence requires proof beyond the focused liveness script and tests.

options.title: Pause for a narrower implementation
options.body: Hold or close this branch if maintainers want a smaller fix that avoids replacing `fs.glob` or changing hook scheduling in this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded compatibility tradeoff
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head gates if maintainers agree the tested walker parity and internal-only scheduling are acceptable for the P1 message-loss fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history and ownership signal for bootstrap read boundaries and hook architecture touched by the PR.
